title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement — Service Level Credit Claims
content:
**Subject.** These provisions settle the service level credit the employer claims for the latest month on its census under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement. When a month's measured availability on the census is below the tier's availability commitment, the employer is given a service level credit, with reason SLA credit and pointing to that month's platform fee line; for the latest census month its amount is settled by these provisions, and for an earlier month it is the percentage of the tier's service level credit ladder for the lowest availability band reached, computed on the platform fee after any bundle discount.

**Whose act the claim is.** The claim is the employer's own act: the support agent works out and quotes the credit, and the authorized employer contact files the claim personally.

## Filing the claim

The claim is filed with `file_sla_credit_claim_b00aa839`, a tool of the customer: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the authorized employer contact) runs it personally. It files the employer's own service level credit claim for one month of measured platform availability below the commitment; the claim lands as a service level credit carrying the reason given, pointing to the platform fee invoice line of the claimed month and carrying that billing month, and lowers the program charges the employer currently owes on the agreement by the credited amount. The employer sees the credit on its program statement against that month's platform fee line.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `agreement_id` | the reference number of the employer's Earned Wage Access Program Agreement, as given to the employer contact by the support agent from the agreement record |
| `related_entry_id` | the billing entry reference number of the platform fee invoice line of the claimed month, as given to the employer contact by the support agent from the program billing records |
| `billing_month` | the claimed calendar month, written as four-digit year, hyphen, two-digit month (YYYY-MM); never empty |
| `credit_reason` | the reason the claimed credit carries, exactly one of the values listed below |
| `credit_amount` | the service level credit claimed, in US dollars, a number with 2 decimal places as quoted by the support agent; any further decimals are rounded half up to the cent by the tool |

Values of `credit_reason`: `sla_credit` — the claimed month's measured platform availability fell below the commitment; `billing_error` — a line of that month was billed above the amount owed; `go_live_delay_credit` — go-live came later than the committed target for reasons on Paystride's side; `late_charge_waiver` — a late charge is waived as a courtesy; `none` — the credit is filed without a stated reason.

## Return

A single text line: "Claim filed: service level credit <amount> USD for <billing_month> on line <related_entry_id>, credit reference <credit reference>; program charges owed now <amount> USD." The amounts are US dollars with two decimals, the credit reference is the new billing entry reference number, and the last figure is the agreement's program charges still owed with the credit applied. A receipt line beginning with "Claim filed" means the credit is booked.
